verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a full, schedulable export to Markdown + CSV with properties as front matter and collections as CSV, explicitly described as 'fully human- and machine-readable', enabling users to leave with their data in open formats; this is reinforced by migration guides showing selective export flows to Markdown+CSV for reuse elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that exports preserve all content types (e.g., images, block references, graph links) losslessly, and no community corroboration of export completeness or ease of full data portability.
